A university degree usually gives three years at a time, a vocational qualification (three or more years at upper-secondary level) gives one year at a time, and the special-qualifications route requires at least six years of work experience. The job must be full time or at least an 80% position, and pay and conditions must not be poorer than is normal in Norway. Permanent residence becomes available after three years. Applicants from mainland China should note that UDI explicitly names China among the countries whose vocational qualification documents are frequently found to be fraudulent, so vocational-level cases are scrutinised much more closely.
法规未按国籍设限，中国大陆护照持有人可申，且不设配额。但官方在资格页面明确写了针: The regulations do not exclude any nationality, so a mainland China passport holder can apply, and there is no quota. However, the eligibility page carries an explicit warning about the authenticity of vocational qualification documents issued in a number of named countries, China included; see the risks section. This does not affect eligibility, but it does affect the real approval rate for vocational-level applications.
官方未设年龄上下限。0-99 表示「无年龄门槛」，不是「未核实」。年龄只通过「工: The official page sets no upper or lower age limit. 0-99 means "no age threshold", not "unverified". Age only matters indirectly, through years of work experience, because the special-qualifications route requires at least six years of relevant experience.
三条路径任选其一：①完成高中层级不少于三年的职业培训，且挪威存在对应的职业培训项: Any one of three routes works: (1) a completed vocational training programme of at least three years at upper-secondary school level, where Norway has a corresponding vocational programme (`a completed vocational training programme of at least three years at upper secondary school level ... There must be a corresponding vocational training programme in Norway.`); (2) a completed education or degree from a university or university college, for example a bachelor's degree as an engineer or nurse (`completed education or degree from a university/ university college, for example a bachelor's degree as an engineer or nurse.`); (3) special qualifications acquired through long professional practice, generally requiring at least six years of work experience (`special qualifications are skills acquired through long professional experience ... Generally, you must have at least six years of work experience.`). Any field is acceptable, but the position must correspond to your education or qualification.
官方资格清单里没有语言门槛，不要求提交雅思/托福或挪威语成绩。语言实际由雇主在招: The official eligibility list contains no language requirement, and no IELTS, TOEFL or Norwegian test result is requested. Language is in practice screened by the employer during recruitment.
不要求存款证明或保证金。取而代之的是薪资条件：`The pay and work: No bank statement or blocked account is required. Instead there is a pay condition: `The pay and working conditions must not be poorer than is normal in Norway.` Pay and conditions must not fall below the normal level for comparable positions in Norway; this is checked against the employment contract and industry standards during case processing, not against your account balance.
必须有具体雇主的具体聘用：`You must have received a c: A concrete offer from one specific employer is mandatory: `You must have received a concrete job offer from one specific employer in Norway.` The position must normally be full time, and `If you have been offered at least an 80% position, we will accept this.` Positions below 80% are generally not accepted.
可从境外申请（须先由雇主在系统里提交聘用确认并给你一个代码，之后你才能填表），也: You can apply from abroad (the employer must first submit confirmation of the offer in the system and give you a code, only then can you fill in the form), or you can convert from a valid residence permit while already in Norway. There is no requirement to be outside the country.
不设名额上限，也没有开放窗口，全年滚动受理。实际约束是「先有雇主 offer」—: No quota and no opening window; applications are accepted on a rolling basis all year. The real constraint is having an employer offer first: without the employer's confirmation, the applicant cannot even fill in the form.
全年滚动受理。流程顺序固定：雇主先在 UDI 系统提交聘用确认 → 申请人拿到代: Rolling intake all year. The sequence is fixed: the employer submits confirmation of the offer in the UDI system, the applicant receives a code, and only then can the application be filed.
规则沿用至 2027 年未见变动公告。费用与材料按 UDI 页面当期版本执行。: No change announcements are on record through 2027. Fees and documents follow the current version of the UDI page.
工作居留许可申请费（18 岁以上，含续签）: Work residence permit application fee (over 18, renewals included)
UDI 费用表原文条目：`Residence permits for work: UDI fee schedule entry: `Residence permits for work for applicants over the age of 18 (also renewals)   NOK 6 300`. Under 18 it is NOK 3 150. A group permit for employers is charged separately at NOK 6 300 per worker.
UDI 在单独的 waiting time 页面按类别公布当期处理进度，资格页本: UDI publishes current processing progress by category on a separate waiting-time page; the eligibility page itself gives no number of days. Check that page before filing: the service location and the completeness of documents both affect duration substantially, and the agency commits to no fixed deadline.
有效期须覆盖计划居留期。: Must be valid for the planned period of stay.
雇主聘用确认与代码: Employer's confirmation of the offer and the code
最关键的一份。官方原文：`If you are applying on your: The single most important item. Official text: `If you are applying on your own from abroad, your employer must submit confirmation of the job offer before you can submit the application form. You will receive a code from your employer that you must enter in the application form.` The order cannot be reversed; without this code the application form cannot be completed.
须写明岗位、薪资、工时比例。岗位须全职或至少 80%；薪酬与条件不得低于挪威常规: Must state the position, the salary and the proportion of full time. The position must be full time or at least 80%, and pay and conditions must not be poorer than is normal in Norway.
学历或职业资格证明: Proof of education or vocational qualification
按所选路径提交：三年制职业培训证书、大学/大学学院学位，或用于证明特殊技能的 6: Submitted according to the route chosen: a three-year vocational training certificate, a university or university college degree, or materials evidencing the six-plus years of work experience claimed under special qualifications. Documents not in Norwegian or English need certified translations.
仅在岗位属需要认定或授权的职业时需要：`If you are going to: Only needed when the position belongs to an occupation requiring recognition or authorisation: `If you are going to work in an occupation for which recognition or authorisation is required ... you must have such recognition or authorisation.` Health care and teaching positions fall into this category.
到使领馆或警务站递交时现场采集，用于制作居留卡。: Captured on site when submitting at an embassy or police station, and used to produce the residence card.
先确定自己走哪条资格路径: First decide which eligibility route you are on
三条路里选一条，材料完全不同：①高中层级三年制职业培训 + 挪威有对应项目；②大: Pick one of three routes; the documents differ completely: (1) a three-year vocational programme at upper-secondary level plus a corresponding Norwegian programme; (2) a university or university college degree (engineering and nursing map most cleanly); (3) six-plus years of work experience under special qualifications. The position must also correspond to your qualification; a degree plus an unrelated job still fails.
拿到具体雇主的 offer: Secure an offer from a specific employer
官方原文：`You must have received a concrete: Official text: `You must have received a concrete job offer from one specific employer in Norway.` The position must be full time or at least 80%. Pay and conditions must not be poorer than is normal in Norway; this is where small employers most often trip up, so confirm before signing that the number they offer holds up locally.
让雇主先提交聘用确认，拿到代码: Have the employer file confirmation first, then take the code
顺序不能反：雇主必须在 UDI 系统里先提交聘用确认，你才会收到一个代码（`Yo: The order cannot be reversed: the employer must first submit confirmation of the offer in the UDI system, and only then do you receive a code (`You will receive a code from your employer that you must enter in the application form.`). Without the code the form cannot be completed. For applications from abroad this step is a precondition.
18 岁以上申请人申请费 NOK 6 300（含续签）。填表时可选择就近的使领馆: The fee for applicants over 18 is NOK 6 300 (renewals included). When filing you choose the nearest embassy or police station for the remaining steps.
到使领馆或警务站交材料、采集生物信息: Submit documents and biometrics at an embassy or police station
带齐护照、雇佣合同、学历/资格证明，现场采集照片与指纹。材料不全是最常见的延误原: Bring the passport, employment contract and proof of education or qualification; photos and fingerprints are taken on site. Incomplete documents are the most common cause of delay, and UDI commits to no fixed processing time.
获批后入境，3 年后可申请永居: Enter after approval; permanent residence after three years
大学毕业层级一次给 3 年（`you can normally get a re: The university-degree route normally grants three years at a time (`you can normally get a residence permit for up to three years at a time`); the vocational route grants one year at a time. After three years you can apply for permanent residence in Norway (`After three years, you can apply for a permanent residence permit in Norway.`). Changing to a different employer in the same type of position requires no new residence permit.
大学学位层级一次给 3 年，可续；职业培训层级一次给 1 年，可续。同类型岗位换: The university-degree route grants three years at a time and is renewable; the vocational route grants one year at a time and is renewable. Changing to a different employer in the same type of position requires no new application (`If you are later going to change employers, but work in the same type of position, you do not need to apply for a new residence permit.`). If you lose your job you may stay for six months to look for another, but must notify the police where you live within seven days (`You must notify the police where you live within seven days.`). Permanent residence becomes available after three years.
许可与「岗位类型」绑定而非与某家公司永久绑定：同类岗位换雇主免申请，换岗位类型要: The permit is tied to the type of position rather than permanently to one company: changing employer within the same type of position needs no new application, changing the type of position does. Working remotely for a foreign employer is not allowed: `You are not allowed to work remotely unless it is part of the job you have been granted a residence permit to do.` Regulated occupations such as health care and teaching require prior recognition of qualifications.
官方点名中国：`it may be difficult to obtain a: UDI names China explicitly: `it may be difficult to obtain a residence permit to work as a skilled worker at a vocational level ... This currently applies in particular to applications for work as a chef, car mechanic, carpenter, painter, bricklayer, or hairdresser where the documentation submitted to attest to educational qualifications or the like were issued in Bangladesh, China, India, Iran, Kosovo, Nepal, Pakistan, Türkiye or Vietnam.` On the vocational route (chef, car mechanic, carpenter, painter, bricklayer, hairdresser) Chinese vocational documents are scrutinised hard and in practice often fail. The university-degree route is outside the scope of that warning.
必须先有挪威具体雇主的 offer，不能先入境找工作。挪威的求职居留只给在挪威毕: You must have an offer from a specific Norwegian employer first; you cannot enter to look for work. Norway's job-seeker permit is reserved for people who graduated in Norway or for researchers (`You must have completed your degree/education in Norway.`) and is not open to applicants from abroad. The order is therefore: land the offer remotely, then talk about the visa.
岗位须全职或至少 80%（`If you have been offered a: The position must be full time or at least 80% (`If you have been offered at least an 80% position, we will accept this.`). Part-time work, hourly work and project contracts generally do not qualify, which contradicts the intuition that any offer is enough.
薪酬与工作条件不得低于挪威常规水平，这条没有公开数字，由审件时按行业标准判断。雇: Pay and conditions must not be poorer than is normal in Norway. There is no published number for this; it is judged against industry standards during processing. If the employer's market rate is low, the case can stall at the review stage even with an offer in hand.
与瑞典、荷兰的取舍：挪威不做「毕业后求职居留」，只有雇主担保这一条路，好处是一次: Choosing between Norway, Sweden and the Netherlands: Norway offers no post-study job-seeker permit at all, only the employer-sponsored route. The upside is three years at a time, permanent residence after three years and no funds requirement; the downside is that without an offer there is no legal way in to look for work. Sweden and the Netherlands let you enter first and search, but only for nine months to a year.
资格原文：`If you have completed higher educa: Eligibility text: `If you have completed higher education or have completed vocational training, you can apply for a residence permit as a skilled worker. You must normally already have received a job offer, or have your own business.` Three routes: `a completed vocational training programme of at least three years at upper secondary school level ... There must be a corresponding vocational training programme in Norway.` / `completed education or degree from a university/ university college, for example a bachelor's degree as an engineer or nurse.` / `special qualifications are skills acquired through long professional experience ... Generally, you must have at least six years of work experience.` Employment: `You must have received a concrete job offer from one specific employer in Norway.`, `The job must normally be full-time. If you have been offered at least an 80% position, we will accept this.`, `The pay and working conditions must not be poorer than is normal in Norway.` Duration: `you can normally get a residence permit for up to three years at a time`, `After three years, you can apply for a permanent residence permit in Norway.` Changing jobs and unemployment: `If you are later going to change employers, but work in the same type of position, you do not need to apply for a new residence permit.`, `If you lose your job, you can stay in Norway for up to six months to look for a new job. You must notify the police where you live within seven days.` Remote work: `You are not allowed to work remotely unless it is part of the job you have been granted a residence permit to do.` Warning on China: `This currently applies in particular to applications for work as a chef, car mechanic, carpenter, painter, bricklayer, or hairdresser where the documentation submitted to attest to educational qualifications or the like were issued in Bangladesh, China, India, Iran, Kosovo, Nepal, Pakistan, Türkiye or Vietnam.`
费用原文条目：`Residence permits for work for a: Fee entries: `Residence permits for work for applicants over the age of 18 (also renewals)   NOK 6 300`; `Group permit for employers (per worker)   NOK 6 300`; `Residence permits for work for applicants under the age of 18 (also renewals)   NOK 3 150`. The same page also lists family immigration `First-time application for family immigration for adults   NOK 11900` and permanent residence `Permanent residence permit for adults   NOK 4 000`.
Job seekers（挪威移民局官方页，说明求职居留不对境外开放）: Job seekers (official UDI page, showing the job-seeker permit is not open from abroad)
原文：`You must normally have received a jo: Text: `You must normally have received a job offer in Norway before you can apply for a residence permit for work purposes. If you are a skilled worker, you may in some exceptional cases get a residence permit to stay in Norway while you look for work.` The branch for people who graduated in Norway requires `You must have completed your degree/education in Norway.`, meaning the job-seeker permit is open only to graduates of Norwegian institutions or to researchers.
硕士及以上（第二周期学历）毕业后可申请最长 9 个月的求职居留，用来在瑞典找工作: After completing a second-cycle qualification (master's level or above) you can apply for a residence permit of up to nine months to look for work in Sweden or to explore starting a business there. It must be filed before you enter and while you are still outside Sweden; you must show funds of SEK 13,000 per month and comprehensive health insurance valid in Sweden; the fee is SEK 2,200. If you find a job during the permit period you switch to a work permit, which can be filed from inside Sweden, but you may not start work before filing.
官方页面按学历与资金判断，未按国籍设限，中国大陆护照持有人可申。欧盟/欧洲经济区: The official page decides on the basis of qualifications and funds and sets no nationality restriction, so a mainland China passport holder can apply. EU/EEA and Swiss citizens, and holders of long-term resident status in another EU country, follow a different set of rules and this route does not apply to them.
官方未设年龄上下限。0-99 表示「无年龄门槛」，不是「未核实」。唯一的年龄相关: The official page sets no upper or lower age limit. 0-99 means "no age threshold", not "unverified". The only age-related rule is that the online application system requires the applicant to be at least 18 (`To apply in the e-service, you must be 18 years or older`), which is a condition of using the system rather than an eligibility condition of the permit itself.
须完成相当于「第二周期（second-cycle）」的学业。官方定义原文：`Fo: You must have completed studies corresponding to a second-cycle qualification. Official definition: `For a degree to count as a second-cycle qualification, it must correspond to either a 60-credit Master's degree, a 120-credit Master's degree, a professional degree worth 60-330 credits, or a postgraduate/PhD-level degree.` In other words a 60-credit or 120-credit master's, a professional degree of 60-330 credits, or a postgraduate/doctoral-level degree. A bachelor's (first-cycle) degree does not qualify. Any field is acceptable.
官方页面的资格清单里没有语言要求，不需要提交雅思/托福一类成绩。所需材料是学位证: The official eligibility list contains no language requirement and no IELTS or TOEFL result is requested. The documents required are the degree certificate and the list of subjects, not a language certificate.
这是「每月」的金额，不是总额。按申请月数相乘：申请 9 个月即 SEK 117,: This is a per-month amount, not a total. Multiply by the number of months applied for: nine months means SEK 117,000 (roughly CNY 84,000 at a rough November 2026 exchange rate). The exchange rate is indicative only; the agency recognises Swedish kronor amounts only.
官方原文：`you must demonstrate that you have: Official text: `you must demonstrate that you have bank assets equivalent to at least SEK 13,000 for each month for which you are applying for a residence permit. In addition to this, you should also have money to cover the cost of your return journey.` In other words bank assets equal to the number of months applied for times SEK 13,000, plus enough for the return trip. Evidence is digital bank statements or similar; if a central bank or equivalent in your country requires a permit to take the money out, that permit must also be attached.
须持覆盖瑞典就医的综合医疗保险，有效期覆盖整个停留期。官方原文：`The com: You need comprehensive health insurance valid for care in Sweden, covering the whole period of stay. Official text: `The comprehensive health insurance must be valid for the entire time you will be in Sweden and cover the cost of urgent and other medical care, hospitalisation, and emergency dental care. It must also cover the cost of medical repatriation, if you need to return to your country of origin for health reasons.` All four elements are required: urgent and other medical care, hospitalisation, emergency dental care, and medical repatriation.
递交时人必须在瑞典境外（`You must currently be locat: You must be outside Sweden when you file (`You must currently be located outside of Sweden`). A first-time application filed from inside Sweden may be rejected outright (`If you are applying for a residence permit for the first time, you must do so from outside Sweden, otherwise your application may be rejected.`). This is the exact opposite of the route for people who studied in Sweden, which is filed from inside the country.
瑞典自 2026-07-13 起对居留许可申请执行更严格的品行（vandel）要: Since 13 July 2026 Sweden applies stricter good-conduct (vandel) requirements to residence permit applications. Official news text: `From 13 July, stricter requirements regarding good conduct will apply to those applying for a residence permit in Sweden, for example on the grounds of employment or to live with someone.` The agency does not ask for a separate domestic criminal record certificate; the assessment is made during processing.
资金要求里明文含回程开销：`you should also have money: The funds requirement explicitly includes the return journey: `you should also have money to cover the cost of your return journey`. You do not have to buy the ticket in advance, but the bank balance must cover it.
不设名额上限，也没有开放窗口。唯一的时间约束是「拿到第二周期学历之后」——官方没: No quota and no opening window. The only timing constraint is that the second-cycle qualification must already be completed; the official page sets no deadline between graduation and application, which differs from the Netherlands (within three years).
全年滚动受理。首次申请须在入境前、且人在瑞典境外时递交。: Rolling intake all year. A first-time application must be filed before entry and while you are still outside Sweden.
规则沿用至 2027 年未见变动公告。费用与材料按移民局页面当期版本执行，最近相: No change announcements are on record through 2027. Fees and documents follow the current version of the agency's page; the most recent relevant changes are the new work permit rules of 1 June 2026 and the good-conduct requirement of 13 July 2026.
官方页面明码标价 `Fee: SEK 2,200`。线上 e-service 需: The official page states `Fee: SEK 2,200` outright. The online e-service takes payment by Visa or Mastercard.
官方不给天数，只给统计：`Complete applications 75% o: The agency gives no number of days, only statistics: `Complete applications 75% of recently decided cases have been decided within: 5 months`, and for incomplete cases `4 months` (statistics cover cases decided in the last 12 months). So even with complete documents you should budget about five months, and the agency states outright that it prioritises complete cases.
居留许可的有效期不会超过护照有效期（`You can never be gran: The permit can never be granted for longer than the passport is valid (`You can never be granted a permit for longer than your passport is valid.`). The copy must clearly show the pages the agency requires.
须能证明属第二周期学历：60 或 120 学分硕士、60–330 学分专业学位、: Must evidence a second-cycle qualification: a 60-credit or 120-credit master's, a professional degree of 60-330 credits, or a postgraduate/doctoral-level degree.
官方要求 `Digital copies of the list of subj: The official requirement is `Digital copies of the list of subjects showing which courses were included in your education.` It is used to check course composition and credits, and is not the transcript itself. Submitting a degree certificate without the list of subjects is a common reason for refusal.
银行流水或其他能显示余额与流水的数字文件，金额 = 申请月数 × SEK 13,: Bank statements or other digital documents showing balance and transactions, in the amount of months applied for times SEK 13,000. If a central bank in your country requires a permit before funds can be transferred out, attach that permit as well.
须覆盖急诊与其他医疗、住院、急诊牙科、医疗送返四项，有效期覆盖整个停留期。: Must cover urgent and other medical care, hospitalisation, emergency dental care and medical repatriation, valid for the whole period of stay.
UHR 学历核查授权书（265611）: UHR consent to verify study documents (form 265611)
官方要求签一份授权，允许瑞典高等教育委员会（UHR）联系你所在国的院校核实学历文: The agency requires a signed authorisation allowing the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) to contact institutions in your country of origin to verify your study documents: `Digital copy of a signed power of attorney giving the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) the right to contact higher education institutions in your country of origin to verify your study documents.` Form number 265611.
多数申请人会收到邮件，通过 App 完成数字护照核验；核验不通过或被要求面交时才: Most applicants receive an email and complete passport verification digitally through an app; only if that fails or an in-person check is required do you book an embassy appointment and have photos and fingerprints taken on site.
所有材料须为瑞典语或英语。用翻译件时须为认证翻译，并同时附上原文语言的文件副本。: All documents must be in Swedish or English. Translated documents must be certified translations, submitted together with a copy of the document in its original language.
先确认学历算不算「第二周期」: First check whether your degree counts as second-cycle
对照四种情形：60 学分硕士、120 学分硕士、60–330 学分专业学位、研究: Compare against four shapes: a 60-credit master's, a 120-credit master's, a professional degree of 60-330 credits, or a postgraduate/doctoral-level degree. A four-year Chinese bachelor's is first-cycle and does not qualify; a three-year Chinese master's usually maps onto a 120-credit master's, but only to the extent the degree certificate and list of subjects can evidence the credit composition. Get this wrong and everything downstream is wasted.
算清楚要准备多少钱: Work out how much money you need
申请几个月就按几个月算：月数 × SEK 13,000，再加回程开销。9 个月即: Multiply the months applied for by SEK 13,000, then add the return journey. Nine months means SEK 117,000. The money must be visible in a bank account, not merely promised.
买对保险，别买成旅行险: Buy the right insurance, not a travel policy
要的是覆盖瑞典就医的综合医疗险，含住院、急诊牙科、医疗送返。普通申根旅行险通常不: What is required is comprehensive medical insurance covering care in Sweden, including hospitalisation, emergency dental care and medical repatriation. Ordinary Schengen travel policies usually exclude dental care and repatriation or carry insufficient cover, so check the policy clause by clause against the four official elements.
人在境外时线上递交，交 SEK 2,200: File online from outside Sweden and pay SEK 2,200
用移民局 e-service 填表并上传材料，Visa 或 Mastercard: Complete the form in the agency's e-service and upload documents, paying SEK 2,200 by Visa or Mastercard. The system requires you to be at least 18, have a working email address, and be able to scan or photograph documents. If the e-service is unavailable to you, fill in paper form 265511 and submit it at a Swedish embassy or consulate-general in your country. The application also asks which embassy you want to visit, for presenting your passport or an interview.
做数字护照核验，等决定: Complete digital passport verification and wait for the decision
多数人通过邮件里的链接用 App 完成护照核验；被要求面交时再预约使领馆。材料完: Most people verify their passport through an app via a link sent by email; if an in-person check is required you book an embassy appointment. Complete cases take about five months (75% of recent cases decided within that period). The decision is sent to the embassy or representative office you chose and may need to be collected by appointment.
入境找工作，拿到 offer 后立刻转工作许可: Enter, look for work and switch to a work permit as soon as you have an offer
9 个月内找到工作，可在瑞典境内直接申请工作许可，不必回国。但官方明确：`You: If you find a job within the nine months you can apply for a work permit from inside Sweden without going home. But the agency is explicit: `You are not allowed to start working before you have applied for the new permit.` Once filed you may start, and only for the employer and occupation named in that application. Work permits have carried a separate salary threshold since 1 June 2026; see the risks section.
官方页面只给「最长 9 个月」这一个上限，没有列延长通道；此处按「无延长」理解，: The official page gives only one ceiling, nine months, and lists no extension route; reading this as "no extension" is an inference. The practical path is to switch to a work permit once you find a job (filed from inside the country, no work before filing), or to apply for a self-employed permit.
这类居留的用途是找工作或调研创业，官方页面没有把它写成可就业的许可。要在瑞典合法: This permit exists for looking for work or investigating starting a business; the official page does not frame it as permission to work. To work legally in Sweden you must first obtain a work permit or a self-employed permit. Income during the search period is your own responsibility, and the agency does not permit working while you search.
必须先出境再申请：`You must currently be located: You must be outside Sweden to apply: `You must currently be located outside of Sweden`. Applicants already in Sweden cannot use this route (a first-time application filed from inside may be rejected outright), which is the exact opposite of the route for people who studied in Sweden; that one is filed from inside the country.
9 个月 × SEK 13,000 的资金要在账上，约 8.4 万元人民币，且这: Funds of nine months times SEK 13,000 must be in the bank, roughly CNY 84,000, and you cannot top it up by working during that period. For a recent graduate this is the main barrier, harder than the education threshold.
学历门槛是第二周期：60/120 学分硕士、60–330 学分专业学位、或博士层: The education threshold is second-cycle: a 60- or 120-credit master's, a professional degree of 60-330 credits, or a doctoral-level degree. A bachelor's is not enough. Whether a Chinese qualification maps depends on whether the degree certificate and list of subjects can evidence the credit composition.
审理周期约 5 个月（官方统计 75% 完整案件）。从递交到能入境可能空等半年，: Processing takes about five months (75% of complete cases per official statistics). From filing to entry you may wait half a year with neither work nor residence status, so plan on the basis of starting half a year after graduation.
转工作许可要过新的薪资门槛：2026-06-16 起中位薪资 SEK 38,30: Switching to a work permit means clearing the new salary threshold: since 16 June 2026 the median salary is SEK 38,300, and a work permit requires at least SEK 34,470 a month (90% of the median). A job that pays less yields no work permit, and the nine-month search period comes to nothing.
与荷兰 orientation year 的取舍：荷兰给 1 年、无资金门槛、境: Choosing between this and the Dutch orientation year: the Netherlands gives a full year, sets no funds threshold and accepts graduates of foreign institutions; Sweden gives nine months, requires funds scaled by month, and insists on a second-cycle qualification. If the goal is simply to stay and look for work after graduating, the Dutch window is wider; Sweden's advantage is that its thresholds are stated plainly, with no hidden conditions such as institutional rankings.
Look for work or start a business（瑞典移民局官: Look for work or start a business (official Swedish Migration Agency page)
资格与条件原文：`You have completed studies equi: Eligibility text: `You have completed studies equivalent to a second-cycle qualification and want to come to Sweden to look for work or explore the possibilities for starting your own business here.` Second-cycle definition `it must correspond to either a 60-credit Master's degree, a 120-credit Master's degree, a professional degree worth 60-330 credits, or a postgraduate/PhD-level degree`; funds `you must demonstrate that you have bank assets equivalent to at least SEK 13,000 for each month for which you are applying for a residence permit`; location `You must currently be located outside of Sweden`; duration `You can be granted a residence permit for a maximum of nine months, but never for longer than your passport is valid.`; fee `Fee: SEK 2,200`; processing `Complete applications 75% of recently decided cases have been decided within: 5 months`; switching from inside `If you get a job in Sweden during the permit period, you can apply for a work permit from within the country. You are not allowed to start working before you have applied for the new permit.`
Employees — work permit（瑞典移民局官方页，用于转工作许可: Employees - work permit (official page, source for the salary threshold when switching)
薪资门槛原文：`you must have a monthly salary o: Salary threshold text: `you must have a monthly salary or wages of at least SEK 34,470`; the same page carries the news item `2026-06-16 New median salary affects the salary requirement for work permits Statistics Sweden (SCB) has now updated the median salary in Sweden. As of 16 June, the median salary is SEK 38,300, which means that you must have a salary/wages of at least SEK 34,470 (90 per cent of the median salary) a month in order to be granted a work permit.` It also notes `Certain professions are exempt from the salary requirement`, in which case 75% of the median applies.
Look for work after completing your stud: Look for work after completing your studies in Sweden (the other route, for people who studied in Sweden)
区分两条路径的原文：`If you have completed higher: Text distinguishing the two routes: `If you have completed higher education studies in Sweden, you can apply for a residence permit to look for work or explore the possibilities of starting your own business.` People who studied in Sweden take this route and can apply from inside the country; this record covers the route for people who completed their studies abroad and want to come to Sweden to look for work, whose conditions differ.
